Prepare and Format Tree for Plotting

dot-tree_prep_labels.Rd

Rescales tree branch lengths to "length_mean" and optionally formats tip labels using zhutilsr::format_organism_name() with spaces converted to tildes (~) for plotmath.

Usage

.tree_prep_labels(tree, format.taxa = TRUE)

Arguments

tree

A tidytree treedata object.

format.taxa

Logical. Whether to format taxa names for plotmath. Default is TRUE.

Value

A rescaled (and optionally formatted) treedata object.

See also

Other tree: .tree_calc_offsets(), .tree_visualize_base(), read_contree_mrbayes(), tree_annotate(), tree_relabel(), tree_reroot(), tree_visualize()
